title: Close GF(p) FieldMatrix gaps to fflas-ffpack
description:
Close GF(p) FieldMatrix performance gaps to fflas-ffpack.

## Background

Mersenne31 is already strong in measured GEMM rows, but GF(7), GF(31), GF(251), and GF(65521) need dedicated small-prime and medium-prime work to meet the 1.5x threshold.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] GF(p) GEMM target rows are within 1.5x of fflas-ffpack or faster across all in-scope prime families.
- [hard] Dense GF(p) rows downstream of GEMM have follow-up dependencies or evidence showing they inherit the optimized kernels.
- [hard] A final GF(p) report records raw numbers, ratios, and field-family-specific decisions.
